# Traefik — multiple-root-context

Two independent apps at their own backend roots, published under /ui1 and /ui2 by stripPrefix. Traefik cannot rescope cookies the way the NGINX sibling's proxy_cookie_path does, so each app is told its public prefix instead — without which both would set a csrfToken cookie on / and clobber each other.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui1/,/ui2/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# Two independent apps, both at their own backend's root, published under
# different prefixes by the proxy. Neither backend has a context path: the
# prefix exists only in the public URL, and stripPrefix removes it.
#
# This is where "no response rewriting" costs the most. The NGINX sibling
# rescopes each app's cookies into its own prefix with proxy_cookie_path, which
# keeps two apps that are identical apart from their name from colliding.
# Traefik cannot, so the apps are told about their prefix instead — see the
# compose file. Without that, both would set a csrfToken cookie on / and each
# would clobber the other's, breaking Hilla for whichever app was visited
# first.
#
# stripPrefix leaves / rather than an empty path when the request is for the
# bare prefix, so /ui1 works as well as /ui1/ and no redirect rule is needed to
# add a trailing slash.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin1:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui1/`) || Path(`/ui1`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui1
        - compress
      service: vaadin1

    vaadin2:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui2/`) || Path(`/ui2`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui2
        - compress
      service: vaadin2

  services:
    vaadin1:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin1:8080
    vaadin2:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin2:8080

  middlewares:
    strip-ui1:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/ui1"

    strip-ui2:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/ui2"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
